---
title: "`r params$title`"
subtitle: Generated from [output_schema.yaml](../../assetsyaml/output_schema.yaml)
---

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Load schema
schema_dict <- yaml::read_yaml(system.file("yaml", "output_schema.yaml", package = "seatrackR"))

dataset <- schema_dict$datasets[[params$key]]

render_schema <- function(dataset) {
    bullets <- sapply(dataset$columns, function(col) {
        knitr::knit_expand(text = "- #### **{{col$name}}** \n *type: {{col$type}}* \n\n  {{col$description}} ")
    })
    all_desc <- paste(bullets, collapse = "\n\n")
    return(all_desc)
}

schema_md <- render_schema(dataset)
```

`r dataset$description`

`r knitr::knit(text = schema_md)`
